title: Concept: Rancher console is reachable without authentication
description: Rancher is the control plane over multiple clusters: its API creates workloads, reads secrets and issues kubeconfigs. A reachable interface without a login is therefore the shortest path to every cluster the installation manages.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller takes the bootstrap administrator account on a fresh install or, with weak auth, obtains cluster administration and secret access.
